source_pattern: Pattern 3: Recurring gap: Reference document cross-linkage gaps
behavior_change: Document currently produces reference document outputs without requiring a cross-references section, accepting deliverables that cite no related modules, schemas, or SKILL.md files; it should reject its own output with CROSS_LINK_MISSING when the produced reference document contains no '## Cross-references' or '## See also' section with at least one entry.
risk: Existing reference documents in _shared/references/ that predate this change lack cross-references sections; if Document re-generates any of them for documentation deliverables, it will block on its own prior output. A backfill wave adding cross-references sections to all existing reference documents must run before this change is activated in production.
rollback_condition: Rollback if CROSS_LINK_MISSING fires on reference documents that are legitimately terminal (no related modules or schemas exist to link to), indicating the cross-references requirement is too broad and needs a scope constraint limiting it to documents that explicitly reference other framework artifacts.
